name: ci-full-check-deadline
goal: Allow the unchanged full repository check to finish instead of cancelling at 45 minutes

evidence: GitHub run 39671924593 at 2bfd74bc5 exceeded its 45-minute job limit. Local full checking reached Reports after passing root units, CLI, build and package checks beyond that deadline.
The standard Linux job test asserted the old 45-minute capacity. Require 90 minutes in that same test; retain its complete check command, read-only permissions and tool setup assertions.
Sealed red e6a6b825 at 113fa03c6 fails the standard Linux capacity assertion; GitHub independently confirms the previous job was cancelled at exactly 45 minutes.
